prompts.ascHeaderPrompt:
Create a premium App Store product page HEADER artwork for Chessticize, a thoughtful chess-puzzle training app. Output a single wide 3840 x 1646 pixel landscape image (21:9), no text at all.
Art direction: refined photographic 3D still life, warm porcelain white and very pale icy blue, soft daylight, frosted glass and satin ceramic Staunton chess pieces, subtle realistic contact shadows, clean editorial product photography matching a warm-white / icy-blue chess studio. Rich material detail, no neon, no purple, no dark gaming aesthetic.
Composition: a beautifully sculpted WHITE KNIGHT is the single primary focal point, centered horizontally and vertically, fully visible from ear to base, occupying only about 33% of total image HEIGHT (from y=33% to y=66%). The knight stands on a genuine planar chessboard of alternating warm-white and pale powder-blue perfectly regular SQUARE tiles. Perspective is modest and correct, camera at slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Board spans the bottom half of the entire wide image and extends beyond left/right edges; the upper half dissolves into a warm-white studio backdrop. Two distant frosted slate-blue opponent pieces, a simple rook and queen, are small secondary shapes to the left and right of the knight, slightly behind it, contained within the CENTRAL 42% of image width. One subtle saturated Chessticize blue (#146dd6) highlighted square near the knight provides the tactical focus. Keep wide left and right thirds quiet.
CRITICAL CROP SAFETY: every essential piece, including ears, crown, and bases, must remain inside x=29%-71%, y=30%-70%. Background and board may bleed beyond that. Make the central subject compelling even if all artwork outside that rectangle is cropped away. Do NOT make the knight huge; retain breathing space.
No phone, no device mockup, no UI, no screen, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no promotional badges. One coherent physical chess scene, not a collage. Elegant, recognizably chess at thumbnail scale, meticulous geometry.
prompts.ascHeaderFinalPrompt:

Keep the blue highlight within y=61%-67%. Quiet negative space and subtle background shadows outside the central region; no added props. Preserve clean image quality and no text, lettering, branding, devices, UI or watermark. Output 3840 x 1646 or matching 21:9 wide landscape.
prompts.ascSearchPrompt:
Adapt the supplied chess-studio artwork into its companion App Store SEARCH RESULTS creative, a single 3840 x 2560 pixel 3:2 landscape image. Match the same beautiful materials and brand palette: warm-white satin porcelain, frosted icy-blue chess pieces, pale white / powder-blue regular square chessboard, soft natural studio daylight. No text, logos, UI, device mockups, badges, or watermarks.
New composition specifically for a compact search card: a slightly more elevated three-quarter camera looking down enough to read the chessboard. A white Staunton knight is the crisp central hero, fully visible from ears to base, with its ENTIRE silhouette inside x=43%-56%, y=32%-63%. Two smaller frosted slate-blue opponent pieces (one rook, one queen), stand a little behind and apart, within x=29%-70%, y=35%-62%, all on the same physical board.
Make the chess-training purpose immediately clear: two distinct blue translucent highlighted destination tiles on the board in front of the knight, each marked by a small simple clean blue arrow directed toward its center, as two candidate moves. Keep them subtle, precise, and unobstructed, not sprawling UI. The two destination tiles and move cues must fit within x=32%-68%, y=57%-68%. The scene should suggest looking carefully and choosing a move, not battle, magic, or a full crowded game. The board has a few clear SQUARE cells, no grid deformations, pieces sit centered on squares with convincing contact shadows. One restrained vivid blue (#146dd6) accent ties it to Chessticize.
CRITICAL SAFE AREA: all essential pieces and move highlights must fit inside x=22%-78%, y=30%-70%. Outside that central rectangle allow only the pale studio background and the chessboard extending naturally. The overall image must look deliberately composed at full 3:2 and remain recognizable as a chess puzzle when cropped to the central safe area. Premium, calm, editorial, uncluttered.
prompts.ascSearchFinalPrompt:
Correct this SEARCH RESULTS artwork for a real chess-training app. Preserve its premium warm-white porcelain / frosted icy-blue materials, soft daylight, no text, and 3:2 composition, but correct the chess logic and composition.
The current straight diagonal arrows from the knight to adjacent squares are WRONG. A knight moves TWO ranks plus ONE file. Replace these with exactly TWO clear L-SHAPED blue move paths on a geometrically regular checkerboard, each with a right-angle bend and an arrowhead, and highlights ONLY on the two legal destination squares.
Reframe from a more overhead angle so we can see a compact coherent 5-column by 5-row portion of a real square chessboard. The white knight stands at the center column of the second visible row. Candidate destinations are the second and fourth columns of the FOURTH visible row: two rows toward the viewer, and one column left or right. Trace each path from the knight's square TWO squares toward the viewer, then ONE square left or right, ending in an arrowhead at that legal destination square. A subtle shared blue stem may split at the bend. Do not use straight diagonal arrows. Do not point to adjacent diagonal squares. Alternating checkerboard colors must be correct across every row and column. No decorative extra grid or UI.
Composition: white knight ears around y=32%, base around y=51%; two modest frosted blue rook and queen pieces behind around y=35%-48%, not on the paths. Candidate destination tiles and arrowheads around y=63%-68%. All three complete pieces, all arrow paths and arrowheads must lie within x=24%-76%, y=30%-70%. Fill the rest with the gently fading pale board and warm-white studio atmosphere. Keep the knight beautifully rendered and hero-sized relative to the crop. This is an illustrative legal knight-move choice, not a full game position. No coordinates, labels, numbers, lettering, device, logo or watermark.
Output 3840 x 2560, 3:2 landscape. Accuracy of the two L-shaped knight moves is mandatory.
